title: WHO: trachea, bronchus, and lung cancers killed 1.8 million people in 2023
summary: The causes-of-death sheet says these cancers rose from 1.1 million deaths in 2000 to 1.8 million in 2023 and ranked seventh.
body: WHO's causes-of-death fact sheet says deaths from trachea, bronchus, and lung cancers rose from 1.1 million in 2000 to 1.8 million in 2023 and ranked seventh among leading causes. A cancer fact sheet gives a 2024 lung-cancer death figure. The year and the wording are not the same, so this card keeps the 2023 grouped estimate.
